items.name: UW Spring 2015
items.information: Welcome to the first competition organized by University of Washington's cubing club! Please register early. We have limited capacity due to the fire code in the venue. Please check tentative events in our website.rnrnRegistration Fee: Base 5$, 2$/event

items.name: Minnesota Cube Melt 2015

venue.name: [First Free Evangelical Church](http://firstfreechurch.org/) & [Augsburg Park Library](http://www.hclib.org/about/locations/augsburg-park)
venue.address: 5150 Chicago Avenue South Minneapolis, MN, 55417 & 7100 Nicollet Ave. Richfield, MN 55423
venue.details: On the bottom floor of the church, enter through side door facing east and go downstairs.

items.information: If you pay the fees online, the cost will be $10 for the first event, and $2 for each additional event If you pay the day of the competition, the cost is $10 for the first event, and $4 for each additional event (cap of $24). (FMC willl be free) The fees go towards the cost of running the competition, prizes, etc. Any funds beyond that go towards future competitions. If you register with a CubingUSA account, you can pay the fees at anytime before the registration deadline.

items.name: Chesapeake Science Point Spring 2015

venue.name: [Chesapeake Science Point Public Charter School](http://mycsp.org)
venue.details: Competition will take place in the gymnasium.

items.information: Competition will take place in the gymnasium. Registration fee is $11.00 per competitor for those who register and pre-pay online via PayPal, $16.00 in cash for those who register at the door.
